stardict_data_dir.description: The directory where sdcv expects to find dictionaries (searches in <path>/dic).

sdcv_histsize.description: Number of recent lookups to save in the history file.

sdcv_histfile.description: Custom path for the history file. If empty, uses default XDG_DATA_HOME/sdcv_history.

sdcv_pager.description: Command used to display long dictionary articles. If empty, uses default terminal output.

dictionary_ordering.description: List of dictionary booknames to define search result order. If empty, default order is used.
